critique: The black field and white particulate treatment are on target, and density is now much closer to the Brownian Motion preset look. However, the t1-to-t4 comparison still shows a strong startup/accumulation ramp: t1 is a relatively open field while t4 is substantially more populated, so the animation reads partly as emission buildup rather than an already-established, continuously agitated fluid field. Several particles also remain visibly chunky compared with the predominantly fine dust texture expected from the preset thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Front-load emission on the first rendered frame so t1 begins with a populated field, reducing the conspicuous density ramp between t1 and t4 while retaining the current sustained rate.
Reduce the remaining oversized white blobs so the field reads as finer Brownian particulate rather than mixed chunky specks.
